staging_copy_2026_11_15._label: added 2026-11-15. Since 2026-11-15 psu_lrs('LRS-350-24') carries leakage_current_ma_max (2 mA at 240 VAC) and the input-voltage derating (80 % at 90 VAC) from this block as ratings. The hand-collected vendor_cad/staging/LRS-350-24_datasheet.pdf is byte-for-byte the file already stored as vendor_docs/LRS-350-SPEC.PDF (same SHA-256), so no second copy was made; this block records what that file says beyond 'values' above
staging_copy_2026_11_15.document: MEAN WELL LRS-350 series, file LRS-350-SPEC 2025-09-12, 4 pages

p2_specification_24v.ac_input: 90-132 VAC / 180-264 VAC selected by switch; 240-370 VDC with the switch on 230
p2_specification_24v.overload: 110 to 140 % of rated power, hiccup, auto-recovery
p2_specification_24v.peak_load: 150 % for up to 1 s, then hiccup (note 7)
p2_specification_24v.fan: on at RTH3 >= 50 degC, off at <= 40 degC
p2_specification_24v.harmonics_note_10: does not meet EN 61000-3-2: not for end devices in the EU on 220 V or higher public mains with more than 75 W average input (exceptions listed in the note)
p2_specification_24v.emc_note_9: a component supply; EMC tested on a 360 x 360 x 1 mm metal plate; the final equipment must be re-confirmed

p3_curves.derating_ambient: 100 % load from -25 to 50 degC, falling linearly to 60 % at 70 degC (horizontal mounting)
p3_curves.derating_input_voltage: 100 % from 100 to 132 VAC and across 180-264 VAC; on the low range it falls linearly to 80 % at 90 VAC

p4_mechanical.base_holes: 4 x M4, screw depth 3 mm max, on 150 x 50, 32.5 from the terminal end and 32.5 from one long edge
p4_mechanical.side_holes: 4 x M4 each side, screw depth 5 mm max, 150 apart, 12.5 above the base
p4_mechanical.fan_centre: 47.45 from the far end, 36.7 from the long edge (top face)
p4_mechanical.air_flow: out of the top face (arrow on the side view)
